blockingLoop.evidence: Asked 'Was it full of fluff (and is it clean now)...' repeatedly across turns, and returned to the filter at the end after the customer had said they would check it.

rationale: The assistant kept cycling through filter, condenser, container and programme checks, repeating the same fluff-filter question even though the customer had said they would check it. It ignored the earlier cold door glass and fan running, and only in the final turn named the overheat cut-out, without asking about the interrupted cycle or suggesting a continuity test or an engineer. No unsafe advice or part was recommended, but the customer was left with no clear next step and no escalation.
